body:
PR #2933 (BUG-2224) review round 1 addressed; new head c411dbb45cc4081fed3327995c9382a5111bcabe.

Root cause of the red live bwrap gate: salvage() still parsed UNPUSHED_COUNT_SCRIPT output as a single integer, but the script now emits a total plus per-ref lines. Every clone with refs then read as "could not count the unpushed commits", so destroy, session end and salvage kept the clone (4 task_2053_bwrap_ failures). Salvage now uses parse_unpushed_count. The tests were not weakened, and the TASK-2053 keep-on-doubt behavior is unchanged.

Also in this push:
- ci.yml live bwrap gate: bug_2224_bwrap_ added to the cargo filter and both count regexes.
- The host main-reachability git calls (cat-file, rev-list --stdin) are bounded by the probe deadline / PROBE_TIMEOUT, and the probe_until comment is updated.
- The per-ref loop is skipped when the total is 0, and HEAD is listed only when detached.

Local evidence: AIDA_REQUIRE_BWRAP_LIVE=1 targeted run, 37 passed. Live bwrap ok: 35 of 35 expected, including bug_2224_bwrap_inherited_refs_end_cleanly_but_seat_only_work_refuses. The only SKIP was the reftable one (local git). make check-ci-fast: 35 gates passed.
Please queue an independent re-review.
subject: BUG-2224 PR #2933 round-2 head c411dbb45c
